title: Towards Multi-dimensional Evaluation of LLM Summarization across Domains and Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the difference between an LLM's evaluation score for its own generated summaries and the average score assigned to those same summaries by other peer LLM evaluators to assess whether the model over-rates or under-rates its own work.

Measuring the percentage of incorrect human annotations that align with a single-view LLM assistant's label (found to be 95.31%) to quantify the extent to which human annotators blindly endorse AI decisions.
